gloss: in the end, after all, as a result

definitions.gloss: in the end, after all, as a result of
definitions.explanation: Indicates an undesirable or unexpected outcome that follows a prolonged process or repeated actions. Almost always implies the result is negative or disappointing. Used in the pattern Xした挙句 (after doing X at length, the result was...).

examples.japanese: ⟦{散々|さんざん}→散々：10323_sanzan⟧⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧{挙句|あげく}、⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{買|か}わなかった→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: After agonizing over it, I ended up not buying anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}った→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧{挙句|あげく}、⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出|で}なかった→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: After discussing it for a long time, no conclusion was reached.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}けた→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧{挙句|あげく}、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}して→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧しまった。
examples.english: After taking on an unreasonable workload, I ended up ruining my health.

notes:
USAGE:
{挙句|あげく} is used to introduce a negative or undesirable outcome after a prolonged effort or series of events. The pattern is typically Verb-た{挙句|あげく}(に) + negative result. It strongly implies "after all that trouble, the result was bad."

The longer form {挙句|あげく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果|は}て(⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧) is even more emphatic, stressing the extremity of the outcome.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Verb-た{挙句|あげく}: after doing X (with bad result)
- {挙句|あげく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果|は}て(⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧): at the very end, in the final outcome (emphatic)
- ⟦{散々|さんざん}→散々：10323_sanzan⟧…⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{挙句|あげく}: after doing... at great length

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧: in the end (neutral, no inherent negative nuance)
- {挙句|あげく}: in the end (negative result implied)
